• Inter Kashi FC vs Odisha FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 8 || 17-Oct-2026 ||
Inter Kashi FC snatched their first point of the MG Indian Super League 2026-27 season with a late 1-1 draw against Odisha FC!
Odisha went ahead 11 minutes after the break when Stephen Eze’s effort went in off Pratik Chaudhari, and they looked set for their first win of the campaign until substitute Huidrom Thoi Singh fired home an 89th-minute equaliser for the hosts.
Goals: KSHI: Huidrom Thoi Singh (89’) | OFC: Pratik Chaudhari (OG, 56’)
